source: Synthetic Symfony HttpKernel requests, persisted/reloaded Symfony Profiler custom collector, real PDO SQLite queries and PSR-3 log events. Raw profiles are deleted before tools are exposed.
projection: Public fields only before the broker starts; explicit bounded output schemas on all three readers.

search.name: perf_requests
search.description: List approved synthetic Symfony requests in items. Compare baseline (before/control) durations, then select a requestId for the other readers.

search.name: perf_profile
search.description: Read an approved request by requestId from perf_requests. Returns query fingerprint counts and timings, never SQL or parameters. Timings include 2 ms simulated latency per query.

search.name: perf_logs
search.description: Read allowlisted log events correlated by an approved requestId. Raw messages, headers and log context are unavailable.

turns.question: Investigate the slowest approved baseline request. Correlate its query fingerprints with its logs and identify repeated work. Do not change code or data.
Now compare the before and after catalogue implementations. Did the joined version return identical content with fewer queries? Keep the same read permissions.
